name: flake-calibration
description: Calibration eval for judge-flake. Runs flake-classify against the labeled flake-calibration dataset and scores the emitted branch EXACTLY against the human adjudication. Pass rate = adjudication accuracy; the per-row drilldown shows exactly which reds the judge mis-calls (and in which direction — burning repair loops on flakes vs. dismissing real regressions), which is what you tune the rubric against. Run it from the Evals page, or replay the dataset through /api/runs/start.
